task: Trusted interpreter evaluates model-proposed bounded JSON search-priority expressions on held-out weighted grids; no generated Python is executed.
baseline: Same six public grid layouts with unit edge costs; shock uses weighted costs.
metrics: Public pass count, held-out pass count, gate path, attention counterfactual, PFM and Governor traces.
controls: Actual 3/6 versus explicit topology-matched 2/7 adapter, crossed with actual, unrelated and masked diagnostic feedback. Model never receives held-out cases.
limit: Two paired blocks from one checkpoint. An exploratory feasibility result, not a confirmatory test of a new intelligence or Outside signal.
calibration: Separate fixture-only seeds model-pilot-smoke, calibration-only-east and calibration-only-west informed cap and ratio. These are disjoint from the random study seeds.
signalMapping: Public failure count maps to a ranked adaptive-profile weight at the diagnostic zone; this is a deliberately designed encoding.
feedbackControlBoundary: Only the model-facing diagnostic text is correct, unrelated, or masked. All conditions still feed the real public failure count into Amelia, so the masked arm is not an all-channel no-feedback condition.
modelInputMatching: Diagnostic text has equal character length; equal model token count is not guaranteed.
